# The wasm gate of IMPLEMENTATION.md M16-S1: the test/logos/wasm
# suite must run under GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm logos test, executing its
# goroutines, channels, defer-resume, and panic-then-park paths with
# the dispatch-free code the backend emits for non-yielding
# functions. Without node in PATH the gate records a skip.
[!exec:node] skip 'node is required to run js/wasm binaries'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/wasm/go.mod go.mod
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/wasm/noyield.lgo noyield.lgo
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/wasm/noyield_test.lgo noyield_test.lgo
logos test -short -count=1 ./...
stdout '^ok\s+logos\.test/wasm'
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
